criticalDetail: C1 WCAG 2.1.1 - Enter/Space on a consent link toggled the consent instead of following the link. sl-checkbox has a host-level keydown listener (checkbox.ts:481) that preventDefault()s Enter/Space and toggles; the synthesized click never fired so the @click stopPropagation guard never ran. Measured, not inferred.

C2 WCAG 4.1.2 / axe aria-hidden-focus - sl-checkbox #onLabelSlotChange (checkbox.ts:535-556) moves default-slot children into a generated light-DOM <label> and sets aria-hidden=true on it (:554), so the three <a> were focusable inside an aria-hidden subtree.

C3 - <sl-form disabled> does not disable slotted buttons. Form.updated (form.ts:186-189) propagates disabled only to registered FormControls and sl-button is not one. Measured: <sl-account-creation-page loading> still emitted submit, cancel AND sign-in with a valid value.
6-review.criticalFix: C1+C2 fixed together by moving the rich consent text out of the checkbox default slot into a sibling <span>, with the full sentence as aria-label on the checkbox (ForwardAriaMixin forwards it) and a span click handler that calls checkbox.click() unless e.target.closest("a"). The checkbox internal [part=wrapper] gap was reproduced with --sl-space-new-md (8px, same resolved value). C3 fixed with ?disabled on all three buttons plus an early return in each emitter. Re-captured: visually unchanged.
